metadata.title: Bar Chez Martineau — Maniwaki's Tavern Since 1889
metadata.description: Maniwaki's tavern since 1889: cold quarts, Caesars and pool at 231 Rue Commerciale. Cash only, ATM on site. Call (819) 449-3600
metadata.ogAlt: Bar Chez Martineau — Maniwaki's tavern since 1889

hero.title: Maniwaki's tavern since 1889
hero.lead: Cold quarts, Caesars, a pool table and good conversation at the bar — at 231 Rue Commerciale.

onTap.title: What's on tap
onTap.lead: No fuss. A real tavern, the kind they don't make anymore.

quarts.title: Cold quarts
quarts.body: The big bottle, served ice cold — the way it's always been done here.

caesar.title: Our Caesars
caesar.body: Clamato, vodka, a spiced rim. Tell the bartender how you like it.

pool.title: Pool
pool.body: One table, some chalk and friends to beat.

cash.title: Cash only, ATM on site
cash.body: We only take cash. Not carrying any? The ATM is right inside.

menu.title: Menu
menu.lead: Easy on the wallet — around $10–20 per person.
menu.note: Menu and prices to be confirmed with the tavern. Call to ask what's on today.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: Chez Martineau has been pouring in Maniwaki since 1889. More than a century of cold quarts, games of pool and conversations at the bar: the town changed around it, the tavern kept its character.
story.p2: Come as you are, get served fast, and you'll end up talking with whoever's next to you. English speakers call it "Marty's". Everyone calls it the spot.
